Hi Elena,

Hope you and the Sunset team are doing well — we really appreciated the close collaboration on the pilot. The results your team shared last week (reduction in inference latency and 30% cost improvement) were great to see.

Quick ask: would Sunset be willing to provide a short customer spotlight or 1–2 sentence quote we can use on our site and on review sites (G2/Capterra)? I can draft options for you to edit — most customers find it’s a 5–10 minute review and we can handle the copy.

As a thank-you we can:
- Send a $75 Amazon eGift to the individual who provides the quote, or
- Arrange a short co-marketing spotlight (blog + social) that credits Sunset, or
- Both, if you prefer.

I’ve attached two things to make it easy: a small doc with sample quote snippets and a short PDF with step-by-step instructions for leaving a G2 review (it’s quick). If you’d rather I send a draft quote and you just tweak one line, I can do that immediately.

If you’re open, would you prefer: (A) quick draft for you to edit, or (B) give us one sentence and we’ll write the rest?

Thanks so much — really appreciate the partnership.

Best,
